blindnessProtocol.statement: Worklist built BEFORE viewing any primary verdict values. TA selection read ONLY caseId, split, situation, verification.by from datasets/ta-bench/cases.json (never verification.state or verification.note). Ownership selection read ONLY caseId, tMs, and owners key-indices from datasets/experiments/wave-a/L-verdicts-*.json (never owners values or notes). K-summary.json and L-summary.json were NOT opened at selection time (only K-summary's top-level key names were listed; it contains no id list at top level). ownership-review.json sidecar NOT opened. Verdicts in this workstream are formed from rendered frames only, written to disk, and only then compared to primary labels.
blindnessProtocol.taSelectionRule: All 29 cases with verification.by=devin-visual-v2-wave-a are split=dev. Stratified by machine-generated situation tags (verdict-agnostic), taking cases in cases.json file order within each stratum: solo x1, two_players+contested x2, multi_player x2, multi+contested x3, multi+contested+loss x4 = 12.
blindnessProtocol.ownershipSelectionRule: L-labeled frames restricted to role=development bench cases (wm-volley-02, afn-sasebo-rally1, afn-sasebo-rally2); wm-dink-01 excluded (role=held_out) and afn-vic-rally1 never labeled by L (role=test_held_out). Within each case, L-labeled tMs sorted ascending and picked evenly spaced: volley 5 of 13 (idx 0,3,6,9,12), rally1 4 of 9 (idx 0,3,5,8), rally2 3 of 6 (idx 0,2,5) = 12 frames.

taTaxonomy.correct-lock: lime true-target box sits on a real live player and that player is the plausible occupant/owner of the yellow start region for this window
taTaxonomy.wrong-lock: a visible different person is clearly the region's occupant, or the lime box is not on a live player while a valid person exists for the region
taTaxonomy.reject: case unusable as gold: no live player, static/graphic person, irreducible region ambiguity, or broken render (reason recorded)

ownershipTaxonomy.TARGET: box is the target player's paddle (target per bench-case definition below)
ownershipTaxonomy.NOT_TARGET: box is not the target player's paddle: another player's paddle OR not a paddle at all (sub-reason recorded in note)
ownershipTaxonomy.AMBIGUOUS: cannot commit from this frame (occlusion/blur/crowding); legitimate uncertainty

ownershipTargetDefinitions.wm-volley-02: near white-shirt player, rear-side view (video wm-volley-nearplayer.mp4, registry description)
ownershipTargetDefinitions.afn-sasebo-rally1: white-shirt woman, front-oblique view, forehand with gray paddle; second player behind (registry description)
ownershipTargetDefinitions.afn-sasebo-rally2: rear-view net player lunging at the net; multiple background players (registry description)

exclusions.reason: bench role=held_out; W14 restricted to development-role material per DEV-only hard rule
